plan.title: [framework-gap] launcher-argv AGY_WORKER_FLAGS misses agy 1.5.18 worker flags (-i/--prompt-interactive, --dangerously-skip-permissions, --output-format, --input-format)

narratives.Description: Add the agy 1.5.18 worker-spawning flags (-i / --prompt-interactive and --dangerously-skip-permissions) to AGY_WORKER_FLAGS in launcher-argv.ts. Today only -p / --print / --prompt classify an agy command line as a worker launch, so agy workers started with the newer flags bypass the dest-worktree gate.
narratives.UserStory: As a maintainer running agy workers, I want every agy worker-spawning flag form to be gated on a dest-proven worktree so that no agy worker starts from the parent checkout unnoticed.
narratives.ImplementationPlan: Extend the AGY_WORKER_FLAGS set in packages/core/src/hooks/launcher-argv.ts with -i, --prompt-interactive and --dangerously-skip-permissions. Keep non-worker invocations such as agy --version and agy --help unclassified. Add table-driven tests in launcher-argv.test.ts for each flag form, including --output-format and --input-format beside a worker flag, and a dispatcher test for deny without a dest and allow from a dest-proven linked worktree.
narratives.Traces: clause.1 -> AGY_WORKER_FLAGS in launcher-argv.ts; clause.2 -> classifier tests with --output-format / --input-format; clause.3 -> dispatcher.test.ts deny and allow cases; clause.4 -> non-worker classifier tests; clause.5 -> launcher-argv.test.ts flag-form table
narratives.Overview:
## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] `AGY_WORKER_FLAGS` in `hooks/launcher-argv.ts` includes the agy 1.5.18 worker-spawning flags `-i` / `--prompt-interactive` and `--dangerously-skip-permissions`, alongside `-p` / `--print` / `--prompt`.
- [ ] An `agy` command line using `--output-format` or `--input-format` together with a worker flag is classified as launcher-family argv.
- [ ] `agy -i <prompt>` and `agy --dangerously-skip-permissions --output-format stream-json <prompt>` without a dest worktree are denied like `agy -p <prompt>`, and allowed from a dest-proven linked worktree.
- [ ] Non-worker agy invocations (for example `agy --version`, `agy --help`) are not classified as launcher argv.
- [ ] Tests cover each flag form.

issueCommentThread.body:
Rewriting the body to criteria-only for ingest; added to the 0.132.1 maintainer release (Scott, yolo overnight). No arc: the fix and files are named. Prior body quoted below.

<details><summary>Prior body</summary>

## Summary

launcher-argv AGY_WORKER_FLAGS misses agy 1.5.18 worker flags (-i/--prompt-interactive, --dangerously-skip-permissions, --output-format, --input-format)

## Context

Directive 0.132.0 on Antigravity (agy 1.5.18, win32) with live PreToolUse hooks active (internal benchmark evidence (private)). Auditing agy --help flags against AGY_WORKER_FLAGS in hooks/launcher-argv.js and testing commands through the live AGY PreToolUse hook.

## Expected behavior

Worker-spawning agy invocations using agy 1.5.18 flags such as -i/--prompt-interactive or --dangerously-skip-permissions --output-format stream-json are classified as launcher-family argv and gated consistently with -p/--print/--prompt and CLAUDE_WORKER_FLAGS.

## Actual behavior / gap

hooks/launcher-argv.js defines AGY_WORKER_FLAGS as only -p, --print, --prompt (compared to CLAUDE_WORKER_FLAGS which also includes --permission-mode, --dangerously-skip-permissions, and --output-format). Verified via live AGY PreToolUse hook stdin: agy -p probe is denied (launcher-family argv (agy) requires a dest worktree), while agy -i probe and agy --dangerously-skip-permissions --output-format stream-json both return decision allow.

## Session notes

agy 1.5.18 --help exposes -i/--prompt-interactive, --dangerously-skip-permissions, --input-format, --output-format, --mode, -c/--continue, and -r/--conversation/--resume (Refs #4219, #4066, #7245, #7346). Source: internal benchmark evidence (private).

---
_Filed via `deft feedback:file` from a directive consumer project (Refs #1709 value-feedback gap escalation)._



</details>

expected_outputs: agy -i, --prompt-interactive and --dangerously-skip-permissions classify as launcher argv; agy --version and --help do not
